import pandas as pd
import json

file_path = env['item']
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

schema_report = env['schema_report']

issues = []
missing = df.isnull().sum()
missing_cols = missing[missing > 0]
if not missing_cols.empty:
    for col in missing_cols.index:
        issues.append({'type': 'missing', 'column': col, 'count': int(missing_cols[col])})

dup = df.duplicated().sum()
if dup > 0:
    issues.append({'type': 'duplicate', 'count': int(dup)})

for col in df.select_dtypes(include=['number']).columns:
    Q1 = df[col].quantile(0.25)
    Q3 = df[col].quantile(0.75)
    IQR = Q3 - Q1
    outliers = df[(df[col] < (Q1 - 1.5 * IQR)) | (df[col] > (Q3 + 1.5 * IQR))]
    if not outliers.empty:
        issues.append({'type': 'outlier', 'column': col, 'count': len(outliers)})

repairs = []
for col in df.columns:
    if df[col].isnull().sum() > 0:
        if df[col].dtype in ['int64', 'float64']:
            median_val = df[col].median()
            df[col].fillna(median_val, inplace=True)
            repairs.append({'column': col, 'repair': 'fill_median', 'value': median_val})
        else:
            mode_val = df[col].mode()[0]
            df[col].fillna(mode_val, inplace=True)
            repairs.append({'column': col, 'repair': 'fill_mode', 'value': mode_val})

df.drop_duplicates(inplace=True)

revalidation = {}
remaining_missing = df.isnull().sum().sum()
revalidation['remaining_missing'] = int(remaining_missing)
revalidation['row_count'] = len(df)

stats = {}
for col in df.select_dtypes(include=['number']).columns:
    stats[col] = {
        'mean': float(df[col].mean()),
        'sum': float(df[col].sum()),
        'std': float(df[col].std()),
        'min': float(df[col].min()),
        'max': float(df[col].max())
    }

analysis_result = {
    'file_name': file_path.split('/')[-1],
    'issues': issues,
    'repairs': repairs,
    'revalidation': revalidation,
    'stats': stats
}

env['analysis_result'] = analysis_result

merged = env['merged']
review = env['review']
results = env['results']

report = '# Consolidated Quarterly Sales Report\n\n'
report += '## Quality Review\n'
report += f'Passed: {review["passed"]}\n'
report += f'Recommendations: {review["recommendations"]}\n\n'
report += '## Per-File Analysis\n'
for r in results:
    report += f'### {r["file_name"]}\n'
    report += f'Issues: {len(r["issues"])}\n'
    report += f'Repairs: {len(r["repairs"])}\n'
    report += f'Revalidation: {r["revalidation"]}\n'
    report += f'Statistics: {r["stats"]}\n\n'
report += '## Merged Statistics\n'
report += f'Total Issues: {merged["total_issues"]}\n'
report += f'Total Repairs: {merged["total_repairs"]}\n'
report += f'Overall: {merged["overall_statistics"]}\n'

env['markdown_report'] = report
